title: ci(nightly-tiers): four shards — the showcase smoke alone on one, the CLI cut across the rest
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_
Fixes #28580
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:夜间分层测试从 2 个分片改为 4 个。showcase 浏览器冒烟独占一个分片,CLI 的 e2e 层切成 3 片,放在另外 3 个分片上。分片器新增文档键 `ownShard`,用来表达“这个包独占一个分片”。
- **为什么改**:showcase 的分片要先构建 Console、安装 Chromium,再构建自己的依赖闭包,约 18 分钟,而它在数据集里只按 48 秒计权,所以总被放到最重的 CLI 切片旁边。11-01 这个 1 号分片需要约 52 分钟,在 45 分钟上限处被取消,没有任何测试失败。
- **风险与回滚**:只改夜间 workflow 的分片布局。没有测试被改名、跳过或删除,两个层级都没有收窄。回滚就是 revert 本 PR,回到 2 个分片。
- **先看**:① `.github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml` 的矩阵和头注释里的数字;② `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` 的 `readOwnShard` 和 `planRun`;③ `scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs` 的 `OWN_SHARD_PACKAGES`。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs --packages > /tmp/t.json && node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs /tmp/t.json --shard 4/4`,预期 stdout 只打印 `@objectstack/example-showcase`,日志有一行 `own shard: ... alone on shard 4/4`。
- **需要你做的**:本 PR 改到 `.github/workflows/**`,属于 Tier H 受管面,需要授权审批人批准,之后由席位落地。

## What changes

The nightly tiers job goes from two shards to four. Shards 1–3 each carry one slice of `@objectstack/cli`'s e2e tier, and shard 4 carries the showcase browser smoke alone. The timeout stays at 45 minutes.

- `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` reads a new document key, `ownShard`. Each package it names runs whole and alone on one of the run's last shards. Everything else is planned over the shards left, so a `sliceAcrossShards` package is cut N − k ways. The key is checked strictly: it must be an array of distinct listed names, none also in `sliceAcrossShards`, with fewer reservations than shards. A reserved package that the run excludes is refused, because its shard would run nothing. The balance line grades only the shared shards, since a reserved shard is placed by the document and not by weight.
- `scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs --packages` puts every tier-owning package in exactly one of the two keys. `OWN_SHARD_PACKAGES` (today only the showcase) goes to `ownShard`, and the rest go to `sliceAcrossShards`.
- `.github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml`: `matrix.shard` is `[1, 2, 3, 4]`, the job name is `/4`, the partitioner runs with `--shard k/4`, and the reports artifact is `-of-4`. That is four places. The header said three, and the artifact name was the one it missed. Two header statements were false, and the measurements below correct them: "≈ 13 min a shard" and "the closure's build tasks replay".
- New self-test pins (live tree): the workflow's preparation step must name exactly the `ownShard` packages. The CLI must reach the N − k shared shards as one distinct slice each, with each reserved package alone on its own shard. A new battery, `ownShard`, has 12 cases: identity when the key is absent, 7 refusals, placement at 3 and 4 shards, the control (without the key the showcase rides beside CLI 1/3), and refusal of an excluded package.

## Why four shards, by measurement

Run 41277375892 (2026-11-01, `890c2a6d`), shard 1 (job 124762188633). It carried `@objectstack/cli 1/2` and `@objectstack/example-showcase`:

| segment | wall |
|:--|--:|
| setup through "Compute this shard's package set" | 0m52s |
| "Prepare the showcase browser smoke" (Console build + Chromium) | 9m39s |
| CLI 1/2 leg (closure build 6m00s + vitest 1631s) | 33m13s |
| showcase leg | killed 1m43s in, still building its closure |

Run 41009107101 is the reference for a complete showcase leg: it took 8m14s (closure build 5m33s, then 160s of vitest). Shard 1 therefore needed ≈ 52 min against 45. Shard 2 (CLI 2/2 alone) ran 25m19s. Shard 1 was killed at 45 minutes on 10-28 and 11-01. On 10-29, 10-30 and 10-31 it finished red, in 32–41 min.

Options, each priced from that night's own numbers:

| layout | slowest shard | note |
|:--|--:|:--|
| today: 2 shards, showcase beside CLI 1/2 | ≈ 52 min | over the budget |
| (a) 2 shards, showcase moved beside CLI 2/2 | ≈ 44 min | about a minute of headroom; which slice is light depends on file hashes |
| (b) 3 shards, CLI ×3, showcase by weight | ≈ 46 min | LPT breaks the tie by name and puts the showcase beside CLI 1/3, the heaviest slice |
| 3 shards, CLI ×2, showcase alone | 34.6 min (measured CLI 1/2 shard) | that shard rose from 31.0 to 34.6 min over 10-28 to 11-01 |
| **4 shards, CLI ×3, showcase alone (this PR)** | **≈ 29 min** | others ≈ 22 / 18 / 19 min; about 16 min of headroom; the whole run is ≈ 30 min, inside the hour |
| (c) raise the budget, 2 shards | ≈ 52 min plus growth | the whole run is no longer bounded by the hour |

The CLI rows at three slices are predicted, not measured. I reproduced vitest's own `--shard` order (sha1 of each file's root-relative path, cut by file count). It puts exactly the 42 integration files that 11-01's shard 1 ran into slice 1/2. I then summed that night's per-file durations: slices of 3671 / 2551 / 1759 s of file time, at the 2.86× parallelism measured that night, plus 6 min of closure build and ≈ 1.5 min of setup.

<details><summary>Per-night shard readings (job logs)</summary>

```
night  shard-1 items          prepare  CLI 1/2 vitest  CLI 2/2 vitest  shard-1 result
10-26  cli 1/2                -        1141s           788s            success 24m42s
10-27  cli 1/2                -        1452s           840s            success 30m46s
10-28  cli 1/2 + showcase     8m30s    1476s           1080s           cancelled at 45m
10-29  cli 1/2 + showcase     0m31s    1542s           925s            failure (a test) 32m35s
10-30  cli 1/2 + showcase     0m21s    1574s           902s            failure (showcase) 40m55s
10-31  cli 1/2 + showcase     5m18s    1595s           1127s           failure (a test) 38m25s
11-01  cli 1/2 + showcase     9m39s    1631s           1127s           cancelled at 45m
```

Same 82 files, per-file time summed: 5532 s on 10-26, 7907 s on 11-01.

</details>

## Tests

Self-tests and gates were run at `a9fdb19a1d`. `origin/main` had not moved since the branch point (`cd065d3698`).

- `node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test`: exit 0. The roster is 18 batteries; the nightly battery has 17 cases and `ownShard` has 12.
- `node scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, `48 cases pass` (floor 47 → 48).
- `node scripts/ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs --self-test`: exit 0. This is the Test Core caller of `planRun()`, and it is unchanged.
- The preparation-step pin was checked in both directions with a throwaway probe against the live file: live passes, a renamed package goes red, a removed step goes red.
- Live partition at 4: shards 1–3 print `@objectstack/cli 1/3`, `2/3` and `3/3`, and shard 4 prints `@objectstack/example-showcase`.

## Acceptance notes

- **No tier narrowed, no test touched.** The same 86 CLI e2e files and 2 showcase live files run every night, under the same `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`.
- **The real-runner reading is this PR's own Nightly Tiers run.** The workflow's `pull_request` paths trigger fires on this diff. The ≈ 29 min figure above is a prediction until that run reports.
- Raise the matrix when the slowest shard's test step nears 35 minutes. The document re-slices the CLI at the new count with no edit to it.
- Observed, not filed: the CLI e2e tier's per-file time rose 43% over 82 identical files between 10-26 and 11-01 (for example, `jsx-gate-manifest-notice.e2e.test.ts` went from 208 s to 300 s). This is the trend that eats any shard's headroom.
- Observed, not filed: the CLI legs replayed 0 of their ~62 build tasks from the restored Build Core turbo cache on every night measured. The header now says so; the cause is not diagnosed here.
- Observed, not filed: vitest's `--shard` cuts by file count, so slices are unequal (4661 vs 3320 s of file time at two). A duration-aware sequencer in `packages/cli/vitest.config.ts` would flatten that, but it is outside this card's file surface.
- Pre-existing and left alone: the partitioner's log line `(N of them file-level slices …)` prints items minus packages, which reads 2 for three slices.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate list (dispatch-gates --commands) and --ran reconciliation</summary>

51 families were derived from 3 paths against merge base `cd065d369`. All 51 were run and every one exited 0, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` included (fast tier: 1937 cases, 373 s). The `--ran` reconciliation reported: `51 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 51 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.

</details>
